name: AFFiNE
description: There can be more than Notion and Miro. AFFiNE(pronounced [ə‘fain]) is a next-gen knowledge base that brings planning, sorting and creating all together. Privacy first, open-source, customizable and ready to use.
one_liner: A single app that replaces both your notes app and your whiteboard app, and — unlike Notion — you can run it entirely on your own computer or server so your data never leaves your control.
buyer: A privacy-conscious small business, law firm, or medical practice that wants Notion-like organization but is contractually or legally barred from putting client data in someone else's cloud.
business_use_cases: A law firm or healthcare practice self-hosts it internally to get team wikis and project planning without putting confidential client data in a third-party cloud.
An IT consultancy offers 'private Notion alternative, set up and hosted for you' as a managed service to privacy-sensitive SMBs.
A privacy-focused startup bundles a hardened, pre-configured version as a turnkey internal tool for security-conscious enterprise clients.

money_ideas.idea: Offer white-glove self-hosting, setup, and maintenance for businesses that want it run privately but lack IT staff.
Build and sell premium templates for specific industries, like legal case tracking or clinical workflows, on top of the open base.

steal_this: Package a pre-configured, one-click self-hosted deployment (Docker, backups, SSL) for a specific niche like law firms, and sell it as a $299 setup service this weekend.
